name: thread-gitroot-into-repair-and-lint-changescope
title: Thread resolved gitRoot into doctor --repair and lint change-scoping (combination-review stacking gaps)
description: The read-only combination review of the 5 parallel framework merges (B-2856/B-804c/B-854c/B-a749/B-1637), per docs/requirements/decisions/story-lifecycle.md, found two confirmed (adversarially verified) stacking gaps where the gitRoot resolution from B-2856/B-1637 was not propagated to two sibling git invocations added by parallel stories. (1) HIGH: doctor.ts repairStoryMetadataAllowlist (B-854c's --repair; def at doctor.ts:942, git rev-parse --show-toplevel with cwd:root at :945) is called with `root` (metadataRoot) at doctor.ts:166. B-1637 threaded gitProbeCwd into the three scan functions (lines 64/73/101) but NOT into the repair call. So on a wrapper-root project (metadataRoot != gitRoot, e.g. ClawCreek where gitRoot=clawcreek and the wrapper root is not a git repo), `lattice doctor --repair` returns 'fatal: not a git repository' and the data-loss-protection allowlist is never installed — the repair silently no-ops on exactly the layout that needs it. (2) MEDIUM: verifier.ts:630 and review-preflight.ts:334 call resolveChangedFiles({projectRoot}) without the resolved gitCwd that B-2856 threads into the channel/concept gates; in wrapper-root the change-scope `git diff` runs from the non-git metadataRoot, fails, and falls back to full recursive tsc (fails safe, but B-a749's change-scope optimization is silently disabled). Outcome: thread the already-resolved gitRoot into both sites (reusing resolveDoctorGitCwd / the B-2856 resolveGitCwd), falling back to root when no gitRoot resolves so plain repos are byte-identical, so doctor --repair works on wrapper-root and lint change-scoping is effective there. Two refuted false alarms (a bootstrap force-add inconsistency and a claimed B-804c INIT-phase regression based on an inverted merge order) are explicitly NOT in scope. Scope: doctor.ts repair cwd + verifier.ts/review-preflight.ts/validate-lint.ts change-scope cwd threading + wrapper-root regression tests.
